parsed.rationale: Both `SoundCloudService.fetchMetadata` (line 50) and `YouTubeMusicService.fetchMetadata` (line 64) live in the same `MusicShareKit` package and exhibit a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.808), indicating near-duplicate method bodies behind a shared `fetchMetadata` name. Introducing a `MusicMetadataFetchable` protocol with a `fetchMetadata` requirement would unify the two service types under a common contract, allowing callers to depend on the protocol rather than concrete types. This is the most idiomatic Swift approach for parallel service types that share a behavioural interface, and it avoids coupling the two concrete implementations to each other via inheritance or a shared base class.
